name: they-keep-coming
about: 13.8 (FR56): a 256x256x32 fresh-game valley, DEFAULT_SEED, crew 5, arrivals on, no commands. A group of 5-20 walks in from the valley edge every ARRIVAL_PERIOD ticks until the crew is 200. Ticks run past the last arrival so every walk can end. Expected end: crew=200 arriving=0. Not readable by main's simd (no arrivals key).
